content: If the training data is linearly separable, we can select two hyperplanes in a way that there are no points between them and then try to maximize the distance. In other words, minimize $\Vert {w}\Vert $ subject to $c_i({w}\cdot {x}_u-b) \ge 1, i=\lbrace 1,2,...,n\rbrace $ . If the training data is not linearly separable, the kernel trick can be applied, where every dot product is replaced by a non-linear kernel function.
